summary: Open spindle imaging exists in BioImage Archive and IDR (Spindle3D confocal stacks S-BSST669, aster-centration study S-BIAD1167 with cortical-pulling measurements, idr0045 zygote spindles), and some archived studies include cytoskeletal perturbations. No repository dataset was found that records spindle behaviour under an applied electric or magnetic field, which is what the 'polarised force analogous to magnetism' clause would need; the mechanical-traction side of the test is covered by images plus the quantitative cortical-pulling data in S-BIAD1167.
next_step: Pre-register a test on S-BIAD1167 and a perturbation study from the BIA list (spindle figure persistence after microtubule/motor disruption); the field-analogy clause needs published electro-/magnetophoresis experiments on dividing cells compiled from the literature.
obstacles_confirmed: Force-ablation measurements are sparser in repositories than the images of the figure.
Repository coverage is model cell types (mouse zygote, C. elegans, cultured cells), not every animal and plant mitosis.
